newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Woodhead estimates upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Woodhead estimates upped.

text.p: -- Mesirow Financial Inc said Friday it raised its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for Woodhead Industries Inc to $1.09 from $1.08 and the estimate for 1998 to $1.22 from $1.21.

-- Mesirow said the company's second-quarter earnings of $0.28 a share beat Mesirow's expectations of $0.27. The results continue to exhibit strong trends that became evident at the beginning of Woodhead's fiscal year last October, Mesirow said.
-- Given the positive trends for the company and continued order and backlog growth, Woodhead has the momentum to reach the new earnings estimates, Mesirow said.
-- Woodhead develops and makes specialty electrical devices and fiber optic-related products.
-- Its shares closed up 3/8 Friday at 15-3/4.
